description: Compare snapshot (快照) storage cost across clouds: the USD $/GiB·month to store snapshot data, per region (also given as the cost of a 100 GiB snapshot/month). Snapshots are billed flat per GiB — no type/IOPS dimension like disks. Filter by provider/region/country/continent/near; cheapest first.

continent.description: NA, SA, EU, AS, AF, or OC

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, SG

near.description: free-text place to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore

name: compare_snapshots
